neighbours.label: Using 'by' to introduce the method or means of achieving something
fire: The technician checked the sensor's accuracy by comparing its readings against a reference instrument.
Our team reduced storage costs by archiving records that nobody had accessed recently.
The investigator located the fracture by enlarging successive sections of the photograph.
Several seedlings survived the drought by drawing moisture from deeper layers of soil.
The editor clarified the argument by separating the evidence from the author's assumptions.
A student reconstructed the missing melody by listening carefully to an old recording.
The report describes several methods by which excess heat can escape from the chamber.
Researchers examined the mechanisms by which these cells resist repeated exposure to the chemical.
quiet: During calibration, the technician stood by the sensor while the reference instrument warmed up.
Our team promised that the old records would be archived by Friday afternoon.
The enlarged photograph of the fracture was examined by the investigator yesterday.
The gardener arranged the drought-resistant seedlings by height along the greenhouse wall.
The editor's revised manuscript exceeded the original length by nearly three hundred words.
A student reconstructed the missing melody using repeated playback of an old recording.
The report describes several methods for allowing excess heat to escape from the chamber.
Researchers examined the cellular mechanisms responsible for resistance after repeated exposure to the chemical.
